note: Ratchet on new-code duplication (night-rick#376). Duplicated added lines in a diff must not exceed baseline. A raise above 0 needs a non-empty reason, a future expiry date, and an owner; an expired raise lapses to 0 instead of blocking clean PRs. A raise inside the diff under review does not take effect until it merges: the ratchet judges the count against the baseline as it stood at the base ref, and the metadata against the new record. Deleting this file fails the gate. Lower the baseline when a PR count drops below it.
